column2: Ghal Bol — onye ozi ezoro ezo
Mkparịta ụka ezoro ezo nke gị.
Ederede na oku olu/vidiyo 1:1 — enweghị nọmba ekwentị, igodo na ederede dị na ngwaọrụ gị.
Ghal Bol: n'oge n'ezie, nzuzo, ozi na oku site na ngwaọrụ gaa na ngwaọrụ

Ngwaahịa na-apụta n'okpuru akara Ghal Bol — ederede ezoro ezo site na ngwaọrụ gaa na ngwaọrụ, nkwenye nnyefe na ọgụgụ, na oku olu na vidiyo e kere eke n'etiti ndị nọ n'ịntanetị. Aha ọha ngwa bụ Ghal Bol (com.ghalbol).
Mkparịta ụka site n'ọnụ ruo n'ọnụ
A na-emechi ozi na ngwaọrụ gị. Igbe nnyefe na-ejide naanị ederede ezoro ezo na-adịghị doo anya ruo mgbe onye nnata kwadoro.
Oku na-ejikọ site na ngwaọrụ gaa na ngwaọrụ na LAN mgbe o kwere omume, ma ọ bụghị ya site na àkwà mmiri nhazi dị mfe nke na-adịghị edozi mgbasa ozi.
Ntinye ọ bụla na-emepụta njirimara nzuzo mpaghara. Kpọọ site na QR ma ọ bụ njikọ — enweghị nọmba ekwentị na enweghị nbanye mmekọrịta.
Nyochaa otu ugboro. Jikọọ mgbe ị nọ n'ịntanetị.
Onye ọbịa na-enyocha QR onye ọbịa (ma ọ bụ na-emepe njikọ ịkpọ). Onye ọbịa na-echekwa igodo ọha onye ọbịa ma na-akpọ. QR n'akụkụ abụọ adịghị mkpa.
Kekọrịta njikọ gị https://ghalbol.com/connect/… ma ọ bụ QR site na Ịkpọ na Ghal Bol.
Ha na-emepe ya na Ghal Bol (ma ọ bụ ha buru ụzọ tinye site na Play / Linux).
Mgbe ha abụọ nwere ike iru, mkparịta ụka na oku na-ejikọ — maka oku ụzọ LAN na WAN na-aga n'otu oge.
Ngwugwu Windows na-ewu site n'otu ebe ọrụ. Nbudata ọha na saịtị a bụ ngwugwu desktọpụ Linux; Android na-apụta na Google Play dị ka com.ghalbol.
Tinye Ghal Bol site na Play. App Links e kwadoro na-emepe ịkpọ ozugbo na ngwa mgbe o kwere omume.
Wepụta ebe nchekwa mwepụta, wee ./install.sh (maka onye ọrụ) ma ọ bụ ./run.sh iji nwaa n'ebe ahụ.

Gotigin bụ akara ahịa (Ebe teknụzụ na nchọpụta na-ezute). GOTIGIN SOFTWARE & HARDWARE PRIVATE LIMITED bụ ụlọ ọrụ. Ghal Bol bụ akara maka ngwaahịa nkwukọrịta; saịtị a bụ ghalbol.com. Onye ozi bụ ihe na-apụta taa. Aha ngwugwu na ngalaba na-anọgide ghalbol — otu okwu. Enweghị akara camel-case dị iche.
Ngwugwu mmepụta x86_64. Wepụta ebe nchekwa wee mee ./install.sh (maka onye ọrụ, n'ime ~/.local) ma ọ bụ ./run.sh iji nwaa n'ebe ahụ.
Ihe nchọgharị a arụnyere enweghị ike imepe Ghal Bol. Kpatụ ndepụta ma mepee ibe a na Chrome, ma ọ bụ detuo njikọ ngwa tinye ya na Ghal Bol → Sonye.
N'okpuru kpatụ Mepee na Ghal Bol. Ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị ihe mere, detuo njikọ ngwa tinye ya na Ghal Bol (Sonye).
Banye maka Ghal Bol. Nhọrọ zuru ezu — ozi-e, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, ma ọ bụ ekwentị.
Gaa n’ihu site n’ozi-e, onye na-enye ọrụ ịbanye, ma ọ bụ ekwentị.
